# Eterno Web Studio

> Free tattoo artist website builder. Enter your Instagram, pick a theme, get a custom 5-page website in minutes. No coding, no contracts. 30+ artists already live.

## What Eterno Does

Eterno Web Studio builds custom websites for tattoo artists from their Instagram. The platform scrapes your Instagram photos, bio, and contact info, then generates a professional 5-page website (Home, About, Gallery, Booking, Contact) in 2-4 minutes. Artists manage everything from a visual dashboard — no code, no hosting, no DNS.

## Pricing

- Free ($0/forever): Custom 5-page website, free eternowebstudio.com address, SEO, booking forms, visual editor, Instagram gallery sync
- Pro ($25/month): Everything in Free plus custom domain, analytics dashboard, AI booking agent, priority support, unlimited updates

## Pages

- [Home](https://eternowebstudio.com/): Main landing page with product overview, client gallery, and pricing
- [About](https://eternowebstudio.com/about): Founding story, philosophy, and values
- [How It Works](https://eternowebstudio.com/how-it-works): 4-step process — enter Instagram, pick theme, choose layout, go live
- [Portfolio](https://eternowebstudio.com/portfolio): live client websites with screenshots
- [Pricing](https://eternowebstudio.com/pricing): Free and Pro plan details with FAQ

## Key Facts

- Location: Houston, TX
- Founded: 2024
- Active clients: 30+ tattoo artists (17 showcased in the portfolio)
- Themes: Geometric, Neo Traditional, Blackwork, Realism, New School, Watercolor
- Layouts: Monolith, Split, Showcase, Raw
- Build time: 2-4 minutes
- Dashboard: dashboard.eternowebstudio.com
- Start building: https://dashboard.eternowebstudio.com/start

## Tech Stack

Static HTML sites on GitHub Pages, React dashboard on Vercel, Convex serverless backend, Clerk auth, Stripe payments.
